cases.name: Tina Gay Hamilton
cases.about: Her obituary said, "Tina was an amazing mother and friend. She loved all of the simple things in life. From horseback riding to, camping, hiking, kayaking, just to name a few. Tina was very compassionate towards animals and other people. She was born in Ohio and from the day she could walk and talk she had to be around animals. I would say that every animal that was dropped off and abandoned on Beechers Springs Rd made into Tina's home. My mother would call me every day crying because someone passed away at her job. Even for strangers Mom had the love and sympathy for them. She will be missed by everyone that knew her."
